title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2611.21362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $\rho{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. translated_title: 你所发布的即你的症状：从社交媒体话语中估计心理测量网络
translated_abstract: 精神病理学中的症状网络几乎完全通过自我报告问卷进行估计，这使得推断局限于特定测量工具所涵盖的症状集合。我们提出了一个直接从社交媒体话语中进行症状分辨的网络估计框架，并将该框架应用于抑郁症和进食障碍，同时使用第三个厌食症语料库作为跨数据集验证。据我们所知，我们是首个从社交媒体文本中估计症状分辨的心理测量网络、将其与临床共同认可网络进行比较、并在涵盖2种障碍的3个独立招募语料库中复制跨诊断语言标记的研究。对于抑郁症，表达分数与BDI-II总分的相关性达到ρ=0.434，21个条目中有20个达到FDR显著性，折半信度为0.935。网络比较检验发现两种模态之间的边差异很少（占边的3-5%），而桥接症状……
tldr: 该研究首次提出直接从社交媒体话语估计症状分辨心理测量网络的框架，并在抑郁症和进食障碍的多个独立语料库上验证了其与临床问卷网络的可靠性、一致性和跨诊断的语言标记。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the first framework for estimating symptom-resolved psychometric networks directly from social media discourse, validating its reliability, consistency with clinical questionnaire networks, and transdiagnostic linguistic markers across depression and eating disorder corpora.
